desktop.notesZh:
会话「格式化输入」不再报「模型未响应」——按钮改为真正调用模型，模型不可用时才退回本地规则。
设置里的「多模型路由」「版本与更新」「推荐插件」「用户反馈」连成一块，紧跟在「Agent 预设」后面。
「版本与更新」中 BAF DSH DESKTOP 的说明分条列出，每条独立成段。
工作流的「项目工程」「测试流」「指令集」「企业规范」都加上淡入效果，与「确认门」保持一致。
变更总览的「排序」和「流程」下拉改用与设置·通用设置·权限相同的样式；排序新增「耗token」「开始时间」，并新增与之联动的「升序/降序」下拉。
变更总览「在浏览器中打开」的看板支持筛选与排序，点击变更可打开查看详情，内容与变更总览一致。
desktop.notesEn:
The conversation 格式化输入 button no longer reports 模型未响应 — it now really calls the model, and only falls back to the local arranger when the model is unavailable.
多模型路由, 版本与更新, 推荐插件 and 用户反馈 read as one cluster in Settings, right behind Agent 预设.
The BAF DSH DESKTOP notes in 版本与更新 are listed item by item, one paragraph each.
项目工程, 测试流, 指令集 and 企业规范 in the 工作流 page now fade in, exactly like 确认门.
The 变更总览 sort and mode dropdowns now use the 设置 · 通用设置 · 权限 style. The sort list gains 耗token and 开始时间, and a linked 升序/降序 dropdown flips it.
The 变更总览 board opened in the browser supports filtering and sorting, and clicking a change opens its detail — the same content as the page.

dsh.notesZh: 上游 DeepSeek Harness 运行时（会话、工具、Web GUI）
dsh.notesEn: Upstream DeepSeek Harness runtime (session, tools, Web GUI)

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-core.notesZh: baseline loader、adapter stub、bafCore isolate 挂载；§22.17 J intake-mode-set 分类改判事件；两档/三档 TierMode + coerce；Worker 关键词死规则过滤（escalateOnly 下 low 档永不改变结果且 first-match 遮蔽真实升档；两档模式 mid coerce 同死），low 档预设包 routineEdits 移除
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-core.notesEn: Baseline loader, adapter stubs, bafCore isolate mount; two/three-grade TierMode + coercion; dead Worker-grade keyword rules filtered out (a low keyword never changes the outcome under escalateOnly and first-match shadowed real escalations; mid coerces to low in two-grade mode), low-tier preset pack routineEdits removed

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-workflow.notesZh: projection、intake、transition、工作流 Tab Remote；full-go-path 七阶段 + drift/abandon/T11；Phase 6 bug 快路径与 T15 升级；Phase 7 verify CheckRunner 接入 stack/guard adapter；§22.17 J：分类弹窗两路径改道（intake-mode-set）+ 缺陷草案五字段 + auto-pop 宿主行（状态驱动自动弹）+ 门弹窗通道；卡死修复 A–G：/baf-go 直绑唯一活跃变更、铸造设焦点、已确认未 open 不重弹、Tab 恢复按钮、mode= 硬要求、setIntakeMode 补救臂、git_unavailable 审计；OpenSpec×Matt 融合：会话提示词节 baf:standard-rules 每回合注入工程规则源；effectiveRouteKeywordRules 透传 tierMode（死规则过滤随档位模式生效）；批次二十四新增 formatDraft Remote（会话自己的模型整理草稿，一次 purpose=draft-format 辅助调用）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-workflow.notesEn: Projection, intake, transition, workflow tab Remote; full-go-path seven stages + drift/abandon/T11; Phase 6 bug fast path and T15 escalation; Phase 7 verify CheckRunner wires stack/guard adapters; §22.17 J: clickable path re-routing in the classify dialog (intake-mode-set) + five-field bug draft + auto-pop host row (state-driven auto popup) + gate dialog channel; OpenSpec×Matt fusion: the baf:standard-rules session section injects the standards source every turn; effectiveRouteKeywordRules passes tierMode through so dead-rule filtering follows the active grade mode; batch 24 adds the formatDraft Remote (the session's own model arranges the draft in one purpose=draft-format auxiliary call)

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-openspec.notesZh: OpenSpec 本地文件适配器：骨架、校验、原子归档；design/tasks 模板 TODO 提示规则源锚点（偏离需注明、测试遵循 testing-discipline）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-openspec.notesEn: Local file-mode OpenSpec adapter: skeleton, validate, atomic archive; design/tasks template TODOs point at the rules source anchors

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-standard.notesZh: 新增 enterprise-docs 资产目录与 enterpriseDoc RPC：11 份 bafplugin 迁移的真实企业规范文档随包资产发布（skills/sora-c-code-standards、sora-python-code-standards 等），浏览器端按 id 拉取全文；批次七增 QUALITY_DOCS（baf-quality 环境搭建/配置真资产）；批次八补迁 python SKILL + SRI checklist 逐字节修复 + test_module.template.c 编目（共 7 条质量文档）；摘要投影不变
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-standard.notesEn: New enterprise-docs asset catalog + enterpriseDoc RPC: eleven real bafplugin-migrated enterprise standard documents ship as package assets (skills/sora-c-code-standards, sora-python-code-standards, ...) served by id to the browser; batch seven adds QUALITY_DOCS (real baf-quality env/config assets); batch eight migrates the python SKILL + byte-exact SRI checklist fix + test_module.template.c cataloging (seven quality docs total); summary projection unchanged

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-quality.notesZh: C 栈质量执行器：build/test/coverage/analyzer 命令注入；占位态返回 policy_missing 与工具版本
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-quality.notesEn: C stack quality executor: build/test/coverage/analyzer command injection; placeholder state returns policy_missing and tool versions

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-guard.notesZh: 工具调用硬门禁：fs/shell 同步裁决 + projection 重读 + 密钥扫描 + 危险/间接 shell 模式识别；install row 注入每个 agent 的 tools.guard；§22.17 J 未决门期间拦截通用提问工具（gate_pending_ask_blocked）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-guard.notesEn: Tool-call hard gate: synchronous fs/shell adjudication + projection re-read + secret scan + dangerous/indirect shell pattern detection; install row hooks every agent's tools.guard

@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-scaffold.notesZh: 工作区 init 骨架三产物：基线配置 + 默认工程规则文档（.baf/standards/default-rules.md）+ openspec 目录；人工确认才落盘，差异文件走 .baf-backup-<时间戳> 备份
@deepseek-ai/dsh-baf-scaffold.notesEn: Workspace init skeleton, three artifacts: baseline config + default rules document (.baf/standards/default-rules.md) + openspec layout; requires human confirmation, divergent files moved to .baf-backup-<timestamp>
